title: PowerShell for Fleets: Objects, Not Text

scenes.say: How do you automate hundreds of Windows servers without losing your mind?

scenes.label: Objects
scenes.sub: PowerShell passes objects, not plain text.
scenes.say: PowerShell passes objects, not just text. That means you can filter and select properties directly.

scenes.title: Check ports, export to CSV
scenes.say: Grab your server list, test each one for open ports, and export the results straight to a spreadsheet. No messy text parsing.

rows.b: Pick only the fields you need

scenes.say: You can run scripts in parallel across your whole fleet using Invoke-Command and WinRM. Just pick the data you want with Select-Object.

scenes.question: Which cmdlet replaces Get-WmiObject?
scenes.right: Get-CimInstance is the modern choice for services.
scenes.say: Watch out: interviewers love to ask which command replaces the old Get WMI Object. The answer is Get Cim Instance.
